creativeDirection: Photographic seaside location image with the year physically cut into coastal dunes, using the album motifs as real beach installations and carefully staged portraits.
scene: A wide elevated coastal viewpoint looks across a beach at golden hour. Huge legible digits reading 2022 are cut cleanly into the face of pale sand dunes across the upper center of the frame, spanning more than half the image width. Below, rows of metal beds stand in shallow tidal water along the shoreline, with selected portraits and motifs staged among them as physical presences.

elements.element: a tall white egret-like bird with an orange beak stands prominently near the foreground beds, its white body crisp against sea and sand
the main environmental structure: long rows of metal-framed beds in shallow water on the beach, with the two small figures among the nearest beds and a small red-winged aircraft overhead

the illustrated woman is staged as a faithful live tableau seated sideways on a large suspended golden five-pointed star installation above one cluster of beds, with small planet-like beach balloons or sculptures nearby
the woman from reference image 4 reclines in translucent lavender fabric on one bed, closely flanked by her two large dogs
the woman from reference image 5 appears once only as a close shoulder-up portrait at a nearer bed, turned slightly sideways against a pale upright bedhead panel
three tall white-framed translucent panels stand near the surf, each catching the low sun and echoing the vertical flare motif
the man from reference image 7 appears once only within a freestanding grid of tinted square glass panels beside the beds, his repeated blurred portrait contained inside that single installation
a large painted beach parasol or circular sign carries the central jagged-grin devil face and surrounding orange-white burst pattern as a bold supporting graphic near midground

mood: expansive, sunlit, surreal but physically plausible

coverSummaries.description: A close-up photographic image of a white long-necked bird with a long orange-yellow beak, centered against a dark blue and black background with a cool glowing haze. The bird faces right, with its wings or long feathers dropping down along both sides of its body, creating a symmetrical triangular shape.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: a white egret-like bird with a long orange beak

coverSummaries.description: A wide photographic beach scene filled with many metal-framed beds arranged in long rows stretching into the distance through shallow water along the shoreline. Two small human figures are among the beds in the foreground, and a small aircraft with a red triangular wing flies overhead against a muted purple sky. Sand dunes line the left side and the sea runs along the right.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: rows of beds standing in shallow water on a beach
coverSummaries.people: two people among the beds, one bending over a bed and one seated

coverSummaries.album: Mellon Collie and the Infinite Sadness
coverSummaries.description: A vintage-style illustrated scene of a woman seated sideways on a large golden five-pointed star floating in a starry blue space background. Several softly rendered planets and celestial bodies surround her. She wears draped multicolored garments in green, blue, and red, and looks upward.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: a woman seated on a golden star in space
coverSummaries.people: one illustrated woman seated on a star

coverSummaries.description: A soft-focus photographic portrait of a woman reclining in translucent lavender fabric, surrounded closely by two large dogs with sleek gray-brown coats. Her dark hair spreads outward around her head, and the entire image is bathed in a dreamy purple haze within a white border.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: a reclining woman embraced by two large dogs
coverSummaries.people: one woman reclining with two dogs

coverSummaries.description: A grainy close-up photographic portrait of a woman with short dark hair, shown from the shoulders up, turned slightly to the side and looking off-frame. She wears a reddish top and sits against a pale textured wall, with black bands framing the top and bottom.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: a close-up of a short-haired woman looking sideways
coverSummaries.people: one woman in close-up with short dark hair

coverSummaries.description: A minimalist graphic cover divided into three tall vertical panels bordered in white on a black background. Inside the panels is a hazy purple sky with a bright white sun flare near the lower center and a few soft hexagonal lens flares and wisps of cloud.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: three vertical panels containing a bright sun flare

coverSummaries.description: A grid of repeated photographic portraits of the same man shown in multiple square panels separated by black borders. Each panel is tinted differently in blue, magenta, yellow-green, or brown, and the man's face appears blurred or doubled by motion as he turns or looks in different directions. He has medium-length hair, facial hair, and wears a simple shirt.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: a multicoloured grid of blurred portraits of the same man
coverSummaries.people: one man repeated across multiple panels with motion blur

coverSummaries.description: A bold graphic illustration with a repeating purple patterned background of stylized cartoon faces. At the center is a larger cartoon devil-like face with pointed ears or horns, big circular eyes, and a wide jagged grin, surrounded by radiating white dotted and orange streaked shapes. Large distressed orange lettering spans the top area.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: a central cartoon devil-like face with a jagged grin

prompt: Huge dune-cut digits reading "2022" dominate the upper center of a wide 16:9 seaside scene, carved cleanly into pale coastal sand dunes so the numbers span more than half the frame and read clearly from an elevated viewpoint; below them on the beach, long rows of metal-framed beds stand in shallow tidal water along the shoreline. The beds are the main supporting world: include the two small figures from reference image 2 among the nearest beds, one bending over and one seated, and a small aircraft with a red triangular wing flying overhead. Place a tall white egret-like bird with a long orange beak from reference image 1 near the foreground beds as a crisp living focal accent. Stage the woman from reference image 4 faithfully reclining in translucent lavender fabric on one bed with her two large gray-brown dogs closely beside her. Stage the woman from reference image 5 faithfully once only in a close shoulder-up pose at a nearer bed, turned slightly to the side against a pale bedhead-like panel. Stage the woman from reference image 3 faithfully seated sideways on a large golden five-pointed star installation suspended just above a cluster of beds, with a few soft planet-like spheres nearby. Add three tall white-bordered translucent panels near the surf to echo the vertical flare motif from reference image 6, catching bright sunlight. Include the man from reference image 7 once only as a single freestanding grid installation of tinted square glass panels containing his repeated blurred portrait imagery within that one object. Add a bold circular beach parasol or sign painted with the central devil-like face and radiating orange and white burst motif from reference image 8 in the midground. Daylight location photography, realistic coastal staging, crisp detail, no fog, no rain, no text overlays; composition led by the physical "2022" in the dunes, then the beds and portraits beneath; warm golden-hour sun from the side, clear air, saturated but natural colours, open expansive mood. The year "2022" appears exactly once as mown dune digits above beach, built into the scene and lit like the rest of the photograph. It is the dominant subject and the first thing the eye reads: the digits span at least half the width of the frame, sit high or centred rather than along the bottom edge, and read face-on and legibly at thumbnail size, with the album motifs and people arranged around it. Reference map for people (the album images are attached in this numbered order): reference image 2 shows two people among the beds, one bending over a bed and one seated; reference image 3 shows one illustrated woman seated on a star; reference image 4 shows one woman reclining with two dogs; reference image 5 shows one woman in close-up with short dark hair; reference image 7 shows one man repeated across multiple panels with motion blur. Copy each of these faces directly from that numbered reference image - same face, hair, expression, and styling - rather than drawing a new person from the description. Hard constraints (override any conflicting source material): Create a single cohesive 16:9 image, not a grid, contact sheet, row of covers, or collage of separate panels. Do not reproduce the album sleeves as framed thumbnails; transform their non-text visual motifs into one original composition. The only lettering anywhere in the image is the year "2022": those four digits, spelled exactly 2 0 2 2, appearing once, large and legible, as a physical part of the scene rather than an overlay. Include no other readable text or lettering of any kind: no other words, letters, numbers, dates, code, glyphs, captions, titles, logos, watermarks, labels, or signage. Feature only adults and avoid gore, wounds, body horror, medical or anatomical imagery, blank or milky eyes, nudity, sexual content, weapons, and hate symbols; reinterpret any sensitive source motif abstractly. When a source includes a person, closely match their visible appearance and likeness to the reference image, preserving recognisable facial features, hair, skin tone, clothing, and styling. Keep each reference person in the pose, expression, and gaze the sleeve shows, and keep every identifiable face sharp, lit, unobscured, and in focus: no motion blur, long-exposure smearing, steam, fog, shadow, crowding, or shallow depth of field over a reference person's face. Expose the image brightly and cleanly: open, readable shadows and clear colour, with no murky underexposure, crushed blacks, heavy film grain, digital noise, or dust-and-scratches texture. Depict each identifiable reference person only once in the entire composition; do not repeat or clone them as another figure, reflection, mirror portrait, poster, billboard, screen, photograph, painting, silhouette, or background face. The only exception is repetition visibly intrinsic to one source cover: keep that repetition within that single source motif and do not echo the person elsewhere.
